instructions.instruction: Use only the installed autoreview binary and installed TruffleHog dependency
instructions.original_snippets: Require the installed dependencies. Do not invoke source-tree internals or recreate the runtime in shell or Python.

instructions.instruction: Read authoritative task sources and pass a concise task contract with --prompt
instructions.original_snippets: Distill a short task contract: objective, acceptance criteria, explicit non-goals, and source identifiers. Pass it with --prompt.

instructions.instruction: Require completed builder checks before review
instructions.original_snippets: Confirm the completed change already passed its builder-owned checks and relevant real-surface proof.

instructions.instruction: Choose exactly one provider and never fall back or run a panel
instructions.original_snippets: Never run a panel, silently switch providers, or retry a failure with another provider.

instructions.instruction: Honor provider, model, and reasoning-effort choices, with Cursor effort encoded only in its model ID
instructions.original_snippets: Pass explicit user model and effort choices with --model and --reasoning-effort. Cursor is the exception: its effort is part of the model ID, so never pass a separate effort flag for Cursor.

instructions.instruction: Use native isolation by default and apply provider-specific web behavior
instructions.original_snippets:
Native isolation is the default and uses normal provider login from an empty
bundle-only workspace. Select strict explicitly only when the task requires the
hardened provider-state boundary and a supported API key is available. Keep web
access off for Codex and Claude unless configured; the skill's explicit
`--engine cursor` selection implicitly enables an otherwise-unset value because
Cursor cannot guarantee web-off. Repository, environment, or XDG engine selection
does not grant web access. Honor any explicit `web_access: false`, which makes
Cursor unavailable.
instructions.relevant_when: Resolving provider isolation or web access

instructions.instruction: Choose local, branch, or commit mode from the actual target
instructions.original_snippets: Choose the target that matches the actual change.

instructions.instruction: Use the real PR base and repository-relative context files
instructions.original_snippets: Use the PR's real base revision. Add repeatable --context-file values only for existing repository-relative evidence.
instructions.relevant_when: Reviewing a branch or adding context

instructions.instruction: Interpret exits 0, 1, and 2 as clean, findings, and operational failure, and allow all-rejected findings to close without a clean claim
instructions.original_snippets: Finish after exit 0 with no findings, or after exit 1 only when every finding is explicitly rejected. Report exit 1 as findings, never clean. Exit 2 is an operational blocker.

instructions.instruction: Never filter valid findings by confidence
instructions.original_snippets: Never filter findings by confidence.

instructions.instruction: Validate findings against the task contract, exact code, and sibling cases
instructions.original_snippets: Treat findings as hypotheses. Check each against the authoritative contract, exact code, and same-scope sibling cases.

instructions.instruction: Apply only the smallest accepted fix and refresh affected builder and real-surface proof
instructions.original_snippets: Apply the smallest accepted fix at the owning boundary. Rerun focused builder checks and any real-surface acceptance proof affected by the fix.

instructions.instruction: Include every accepted fix in the frozen target and rerun with the same provider and task contract
instructions.original_snippets: Confirm every fix belongs to the next frozen target. For branch mode, commit fixes on the branch; for commit mode, amend them into the reviewed commit. Rerun autoreview with the same provider, target semantics, and task contract.

instructions.instruction: Discard source_changed results and freeze a new run
instructions.original_snippets: If the CLI reports source_changed, discard the review and freeze a new run.

instructions.instruction: Retry only malformed protocol output and never other failures
instructions.original_snippets: The CLI may make one configured protocol retry against the same frozen target. It never retries authentication, capability, timeout, cancellation, or provider process failures.

instructions.instruction: Do not manually recover ambiguous Cursor output
instructions.original_snippets: Fences, ambiguous braces, JSON-value prefixes, multiple objects, and suffix prose fail closed.

instructions.instruction: Do not bypass secret scanning or security refusals
instructions.original_snippets: Do not bypass a secret-scan, sensitive-path, size, binary-data, symlink, revision, capability, isolation, or source-change refusal.

instructions.instruction: Search existing issues before creating a sanitized public defect report
instructions.original_snippets: Search open and closed issues in uinaf/autoreview.
instructions.relevant_when: A reproducible non-security CLI defect is found

instructions.instruction: Exclude sensitive review and provider data from public issues
instructions.original_snippets: Never include frozen bundles, prompts, reviewed source, diffs, private paths, repository identities, credentials, environment dumps, or raw provider output.

instructions.instruction: Route suspected vulnerabilities to private reporting
instructions.original_snippets: Never open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability; use the repository's private vulnerability reporting path.

instructions.instruction: Report sources, redacted command, verification, finding decisions, and final status
instructions.original_snippets: Report the task-context sources, exact review command with sensitive values redacted, refreshed builder and real-surface proof, accepted and rejected findings, issue URL if one was safely created, and the final clean result, all-rejected findings result, or operational blocker.
